Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An entity that is authorized to issue identification credentials.
Class that describes an instance of VirtualHardware.
A evidenceUID is a unique identifier assigned to an entity, item, or requirement.
Abstract ancestor class for all VEX relationships.
Provides a place for the SPDX data creator to record the Package-URL for a software Package.
RoleRelationship represents a relationship between an entity holding a role and the scope or context in which that role applies. The givenRole property specifies the role assigned.

Provide the enumeration of possible decisions in the [Stakeholder-Specific Vulnerability Categorization (SSVC) decision tree](https://www.cisa.gov/stakeholder-specific-vulnerability-categorization-ssvc).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element doesn't fit into any of the other categories.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: categorical
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data that is classified into a discrete number of categories, such as the eye color of a population of people.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: availableFrom
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is available from the additional supplier described by each `to` Element.
A type of extension consisting of a list of name value pairs.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isni
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Name Identifier (ISNI)](https://isni.org/page/what-is-isni/) is a unique identifier used to distinguish the public identities of parties involved in the creation, production, and distribution of media content. Standardized by [ISO 27729](https://www.iso.org/standard/87177.html), it consists of 16 characters—15 digits plus a final check character—and is often represented as a URI, such as `https://isni.org/isni/000000012146438X`.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing this version, or any later version, of the indicated License.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: scrapingScript
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset provider is not making available the underlying data and the dataset shall be reassembled, typically using the provided script for scraping the data.
A product specification (product spec) is a detailed document that outlines the technical, functional, and design requirements of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A key validation protocol not covered by one of the other KeyValidationProtocolType.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: ark
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Archival Resource Key (ARK)](https://arks.org/about/), is a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) suited to being a persistent identifier for information objects of any type, standardized by the [ARK Identifier Scheme](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kunze-ark/) Internet-Draft. It consists of the "ark:" label followed by a Name Assigning Authority Number, a forward slash, a name, and an optional qualifier (e.g., `ark:12148/btv1b8449691v/f29`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: riskAssessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a risk assessment for a package.
Specifies the time an artifact was released.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: lexid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: LEX Identifier is a Uniform Resource Name (URN) for sources of law within the [LEX namespace](https://www.iana.org/assignments/urn-formal/lex), as defined in [RFC 9676](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9676/) (e.g., `urn:lex:it:stato:decreto.legislativo:2018-08-10;101`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasContactPoint
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Artifact has each `to` Agent as a contact point. The use of the `hasContactPoint` type is constrained to `ContactPointRelationship` classed relationships. The type of contact can be specified using a `contactType` property on the `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: validatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been validated on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: service
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Service profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOutput
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element generates each `to` Element as an output.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: application
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software application.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: limitedSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and there is limited support available from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
The point in time when an element or an action starts, becomes applicable, or becomes valid.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: source
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM created directly from the development environment, source files, and included dependencies used to build a product artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evaluatedOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has been evaluated on the `to` Element(s).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: fixedIn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A `from` /Security/Vulnerability has been fixed in each `to` Element. The use of the `fixedIn` type is constrained to `/Security/VexFixedVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.
responsibilityCategory classifies the nature or domain of a responsibility transfer.
HarvestAction represents the act of creating a product by directly extracting goods or materials from nature.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: manifest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a software manifest.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is verifiedBy, from must be a Requirement

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates elements as products where the impact of a vulnerability is being investigated.
Provides the license under which the SPDX documentation of the Element can be used.

**DEPRECATED in SPDX 3.1.** Use [/Core/version](../../Core/Properties/version.md) instead.
Identify the version of a package.
A Package that contains AI software or an AI model.
An actual change to a product's location.
Links a vulnerability and elements representing products (in the VEX sense) where a fix has been applied and are no longer affected.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: affects
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability, Action or DefinedProcess affects each `to` Element.
Harvest is the process of extracting goods or products from nature.
Abstract ancestor class for all vulnerability assessments.
The AssemblyProcess represents the process of creating a product by assembling a set of components, potentially in a way that allows for at disassembly (at least partially).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasAssociatedVulnerability
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Used to associate a `from` Artifact with each `to` /Security/Vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: timeseries
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded in an ordered sequence of timestamped entries, such as the price of a stock over the course of a day.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during an element's design.
A class for describing the energy consumption incurred by an AI model in different stages of its lifecycle.
Provides an unambiguous mechanism for conveying a URI fragment portion of an Element ID.
A prescribed change to a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: eolNotice
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the End Of Sale (EOS) and/or End Of Life (EOL) information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: symlink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: This file represents a symbolic link (soft link).
An Individual Value for License when no assertion can be made about its actual value.
AssemblyAction represents the event of creating a product by assembling individual components.
Provides functional safety context for an existing lifecycle-scoped relationship.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: audit
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: An examination typically focusing on compliance with policies, standards, or regulations. Usually this is done during an audit meeting, while the assessment also involves deep and detailed reviews of work products (e.g. requirements, verification specifications, reports etc.)
A verificationUID is a unique identifier assigned to a Verification item.
Link to the project contract.
Provide consumers with comments by the creator of the Element about the Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: platform
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element represents a runtime environment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: report
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Structured documentation of test results, inspections, or analyses.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: swid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Concise Software Identification (CoSWID) tag, as defined in [RFC 9393](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc9393/) Section 2.3.
An actual alteration of a product.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: tracedToDetail
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement is refined and further elaborated by each `to` Requirement, which contains more detailed implementation information.
A QUDT (Quantity, Unit, Dimension and Type) unit applied to measurement criteria based on product type, region, and use.
Identifies the name of an Element as designated by the creator.
A collection of SPDX Elements that could potentially be serialized.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: evidenceUID
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The unique identifier used by a reporting management system or any other lifecycle management tool to uniquely identify an evidence relationship item.
A software agent.
Use Process defines actions used by elements.
Specifies the value of the content identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasOptionalDependency
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element optionally depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: directDownload
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is publicly available and can be downloaded directly.
A collection of Elements, not necessarily with unifying context.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sha3_512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SHA-3 with a digest length of 512, as defined in [FIPS 202](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/fips/202/final).
This is the agent that performed the act of destroying the item.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact is in active development and is not considered ready for formal support from the supplier.
Provides information about the completeness of relationships.
Describes a sensor used for collecting the data.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: qualityAssessmentReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a quality assessment for a package.
A tuple of two positive integers that define a range.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Hardware/Hardware is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Provides a reference number that can be used to understand how to parse and interpret an Element.
This individual element was defined by the spec.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: partialAutomation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Level 2 - Partial automation or task automation. Some sub-functions of the system are fully automated while the system remain under control of an external agent. The system can perform actions for an approved task without requiring the agent's continuous direct control.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasResolution
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /SupplyChain/ResolutionAction points to the `to` /SupplyChain/OutOfSpecAction that is addressed.
Records any relevant background information or additional comments about the origin of the package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: active
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A requirement has been approved by stakeholder, and can be include in traceability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: reportedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability was first reported to a project, vendor, or tracking database for formal identification by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Core/Artifact is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Product Part Number as defined by OEM.
Property describing a parameter used in an instance of a build.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: cpe22
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Common Platform Enumeration Specification 2.2](https://cpe.mitre.org/files/cpe-specification_2.2.pdf).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: specification
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a plan, guideline or strategy how to create, perform or analyze an application.
A state is an instance that describes what a system, component, subsystem, process, or project has achieved at any given time.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: configures
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is a configuration applied to each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: staticAnalysisReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a static analysis report for a package.
A physical location is a tangible, geographically identifiable place where objects, people, or assets exist or operate.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: complete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known to be exhaustive.
The ProcessReadinessType is defined by the enumeration.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The artifact has been released, and is supported from the supplier. There is a validUntilDate that can provide additional information about the duration of support.
ISO level of automation.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A contact point for support.
ResponsibilityChangeAction refers to the transfer of responsibility from one party to another.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is affects, from must be a Vulnerability, Action, or DefinedProcess

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: metrics
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to metrics related to a package such as OpenSSF scorecards.
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier of the artifact content, that may be used for verifying its identity and/or integrity.
Refers to an abstract, conceptual software entity.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where all elements apply.
The class that helps note down the quantity of energy consumption and the unit used for measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: altWebPage
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to an alternative web page.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: underInvestigationFor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability impact is being investigated for each `to` Element. The use of the `underInvestigationFor` type is constrained to `/Security/VexUnderInvestigationVulnAssessmentRelationship` classed relationships.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDeletedFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a file deleted from the `from` Element (`from` hasDeletedFile `to`).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: crystalsDilithium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Dilithium](https://pq-crystals.org/dilithium/)

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noSupport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: There is no support for the artifact from the supplier, consumer assumes any support obligations.
Provides information about the creation of the Element.
Domain in which the AI package can be used.
Points to a resource outside the scope of the SPDX 3 content that provides additional characteristics of an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasUninstall
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has each `to` Artifact uninstalled (removed from position for use) from it during a LifecycleScopeType period. To express the Agent doing the uninstall, link this relationship as the `from` in `performedBy`.
A Package that contains a dataset.

rdf:Description.sh:message: Class is known to not derive from Extension and cannot be used

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: verifiedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Requirement that has verification (test, review, analysis etc.) details defined in the `to` /FunctionalSafety/RequirementVerification.
Provides additional purpose information of the software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: medium
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The third-highest level of risk posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: deployed
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM provides an inventory of software that is present on a system. This may be an assembly of other SBOMs that combines analysis of configuration options, and examination of execution behavior in a (potentially simulated) deployment environment.
Portion of an AnyLicenseInfo representing a set of licensing information where only one of the elements applies.
A license or a license addition that is not listed on the SPDX License List.
A prescribed alteration of a product.
A rationale is supporting information that provides the underlying justification or reasoning for an associated element, decision, or process.
Results of general safety risk assessment of the AI system.
Provides a map of a property name to a value.
The name of the recipient expressed in text.
Enumeration of verification types.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dalA
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Design Assurance Level A for aviation software assurance.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: development
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A relationship has specific context implications during development phase of an element.
The length along the x-axis.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is performedBy, to must be an Agent

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: gtin
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Global Trade Item Number (GTIN)](https://www.gs1.org/standards/id-keys/gtin) is a number, assigned by GS1, that uniquely identifies a trade item (product or service).
An element of hardware and/or software utilized to carry out a particular function.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: incomplete
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The relationship is known not to be exhaustive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: coordinatedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` /Security/Vulnerability is coordinatedBy the `to` Agent(s) (vendor, researcher, or consumer agent).

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amberStrict
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Limited distribution - organization only. The dataset shall be shared only with specific organizations on a need-to-know basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasStaticLink
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element statically links in each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Identifies an external Element used within an SpdxDocument but defined external to that SpdxDocument.
References an Element on the right-hand side of a relationship.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is tracedToDetail, from must be a Requirement
When relationship is hasDynamicLink, class must be LifecycleScopedRelationship

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDataFile
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element treats each `to` Element as a data file. A data file is an artifact that stores data required or optional for the `from` Element's functionality. The `hasDataFile` relationship does not imply a dependency. Examples of data files include database files, index files, log files, AI model files, calibration data files, temporary files, and backup files. For configuration data, build input data, build output data, test artifacts, test datasets, and training datasets, the more specific relationship types `configures`, `hasInput`, `hasOutput`, `hasTest`, `testedOn`, and `trainedOn` shall be used, respectively.
Provides a numerical (0-10) representation of the severity of a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: securityOther
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to related security information of unspecified type.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: custody
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Custody refers to the responsibility, control, and safekeeping of an asset, person, or legal entity. It involves both physical possession and legal accountability over something.
Type of data in a dataset.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is delegatedTo, from must be an Agent

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasTest
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is a test artifact for the `from` Element (`from` hasTest `to`), during a LifecycleScopeType period.
Provides an SSVC assessment for a vulnerability.
Verification preconditions are initial criteria that are to be met prior to initiating the verification method.
Specifies the version of a VEX statement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amendedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is amended by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: clickthrough
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Dataset is not publicly available and can only be accessed after affirmatively accepting terms on a clickthrough webpage.
Refers to any unit of content that can be associated with a distribution of software.
Expression for the export control classification.
A location where a package or an item will be picked up.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: funding
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to funding information related to a package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: secureSoftwareAttestation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to information assuring that the software is developed using security practices as defined by [NIST SP 800-218 Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) Version 1.1](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/218/final) or [CISA Secure Software Development Attestation Form](https://www.cisa.gov/resources-tools/resources/secure-software-development-attestation-form).
Specifies an Element as subject of an assessment.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assumes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element assumes each `to` /FunctionalSafety/Assumption.
An action of crossing a boundary is defined in this class.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is hasHost, class must be LifecycleScopedRelationship

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: rorid
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [Research Organization Registry (ROR) identifier](https://ror.org/about/) is a unique identifier for research and funding organization, typically expressed in its preferred URI form such as `https://ror.org/02mhbdp94`.
An inspection action refers to a specific activity or set of activities performed during an inspection to examine, verify, or evaluate an item, process, or system.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is hasProvidedDependency, class must be LifecycleScopedRelationship
When relationship is reportedBy, from must be a Vulnerability

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: dependsOn
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element depends on each `to` Element, during a LifecycleScopeType period.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: pass
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates a successful evaluation where the requirement or condition is clearly met.
Provide an enumerated set of lifecycle phases that can provide context to relationships.
Specifies an Extension characterization of some aspect of an Element.
Class that describes a process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Any other units of energy measurement.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isrc
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: [International Standard Recording Code (ISRC)](https://isrc.ifpi.org/isrc-standard) is a unique 12-character alphanumeric identifier for sound recordings and music video recordings standardized by [ISO 3901](https://www.iso.org/standard/64817.html). While the "ISRC" label and grouping hyphens used for human readability, they shall be omitted when the identifier is stored electronically (e.g., `USCA28900153`).
Identifies the full text of a LicenseAddition, in SPDX templating format.
Energy consumed when training the AI model that is being used in the AI system.
A reference to a resource identifier defined outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: support
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the software support channel or other support information for a package.
A LicenseAddition participating in a 'with addition' model.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: asilA
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Automotive Safety Integrity Level A under ISO 26262.
Provide context for a contact point relationship from an Artifact to an Agent.
Anonymization methods used.
A canonical, unique, immutable identifier.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: buildSystem
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to the build system used to create or publish the package.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: yes
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Indicates presence of the field.

The physical mass of a hardware component.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: isci
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: International Standard Collection Identifier (ISCI) is a variable-length identifier standardized by [ISO 27730](https://www.iso.org/standard/44293.html) for identifying collections held by libraries, archives, museums, and other memory institutions. It consists of two parts: the identifier for the assigning organization (an ISIL) enclosed in square brackets, followed by a local collection identifier string (e.g., `[FR-751041001]Casadesus1`).
Specifies whether a license or additional text identifier has been marked as deprecated.
Uniquely identifies an external element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: amber
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Limited distribution - organization and clients. The dataset shall be shared only with specific organizations and their clients on a need-to-know basis.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: numeric
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data consists only of numeric entries.
Provides a CVSS version 3 assessment for a vulnerability.

rdf:Description.sh:message: When relationship is hasInstall, to must be an Artifact

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: blake2b512
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: BLAKE2b algorithm with a digest size of 512, as defined in [RFC 7693](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc7693/) Section 4.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: assessment
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A systematic examination of a system, process, or outcome to evaluate compliance of specific work products with a specific expectation with a specification, regulation or standard. Often involves judgement and a rationale of this judgement.
The Boundary Definition Process refers to the process class used to produce boundaries.
Provides a reference to a resource outside the scope of SPDX 3 content that uniquely identifies an Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: sensor
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Data is recorded from a physical sensor, such as a thermometer reading or biometric device.
Base domain class from which all other SPDX 3 domain classes derive.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: noAssertion
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Makes no assertion about the field.

rdf:Description.sh:message: https://spdx.org/rdf/3/terms/Security/VulnAssessmentRelationship is an abstract class and should not be instantiated directly. Instantiate a subclass instead.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: other
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Every `to` Element is related to the `from` Element where the relationship type is not described by any of the SPDX relationship types (this relationship is directionless).
Artifact representing a serialization instance of SPDX data containing the definition of a particular Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: serious
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The highest level of risk posed by an AI system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element has a role in the `to` Element. The use of the hasRoleIn is constrained to `RoleRelationship` classed relationships.
How the dataset was collected.
A distinct article or unit related to Software.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: design
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: SBOM of intended, planned software project or product with included components (some of which may not yet exist) for a new software artifact.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: hasDocumentation
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The `from` Element is documented by each `to` Element.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: regulation

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: security
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The element follows the Security profile specification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: certificationReport
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: A reference to a certification report for a package from an accredited/independent body.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: demonstration
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Demonstrating and monitoring or recording that the item under verification to confirm that a requirement is met by the item under verification.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: republishedBy
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Designates a `from` /Security/Vulnerability's details were tracked, aggregated, and/or enriched to improve context (i.e. NVD) by each `to` Agent.

rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is an operating system.

The destruction process is defined in this process.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: test
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: The Element is a test used to verify functionality on a software element.
Provides information about the primary purpose of the software artifact.

A gitoid may represent either an [Artifact Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-identifier-types) for the software artifact or an [Input Manifest Identifier](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#input-manifest-identifier) for the software artifact's associated [Artifact Input Manifest](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-input-manifest); this ambiguity exists because the Artifact Input Manifest is itself an artifact, and the gitoid of that artifact is its valid identifier. Gitoids calculated on software artifacts (Snippet, File, or Package Elements) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 SoftwareArtifact's contentIdentifier property. Gitoids calculated on the Artifact Input Manifest (Input Manifest Identifier) should be recorded in the SPDX 3 Element's externalIdentifier property. See [OmniBOR Specification](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/), a minimalistic specification for describing software [Artifact Dependency Graphs](https://github.com/omnibor/spec/blob/eb1ee5c961c16215eb8709b2975d193a2007a35d/spec/SPEC.md#artifact-dependency-graph-adg).
